unit_vocabulary.meaning: prep. (1) 据(……所说)；(2) 根据；依据；按照
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: According to the weather report, it will rain tomorrow afternoon.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 根据天气预报，明天下午会下雨。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: ac-(加强) + cord(心，一致) + ing -> 心意一致地 -> 按照，根据。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` (1) 优点；(2) 有利条件；有利因素；优势
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: What's the advantage of the WindWing?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 反义记忆: advance (前进) -> 走在别人前面就拥有优势 (advantage)，反义词加 dis-。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 冒险；冒险活动；投机 `v.` 探险；冒险；拿……冒险；使冒风险
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Adventure Reading club
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: ad (去) + venture (风险) -> 冒险，历险

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 乐趣；开心；娱乐；消遣活动；娱乐活动；(游乐场等的)娱乐设施
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Disneyland is a popular amusement park for children and adults alike.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 迪士尼乐园是深受儿童和成年人喜爱的游乐园。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: v. amuse(使高兴) + -ment(名词后缀) -> 让人开心的事 -> 娱乐，乐趣。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 祖先；祖宗；原始种型；原种；原型
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We should always remember our ancestors and the hard work they did.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 我们应该永远铭记我们的祖先以及他们付出的辛勤努力。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: ance(前) + stor(站立) -> 站在我们前面的人 -> 祖先。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The headmaster made an important announcement during the morning assembly.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 校长在早会上作了一项重要宣布。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: v. announce(宣布) + -ment(名词后缀) -> 宣布，公告。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: You should apologize to your classmate for breaking his ruler.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 你弄坏了同学的尺子，应该向他道歉。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: apo-(远离、反) + log(说话) -> 为自己的言行说抱歉的话 -> 道歉。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 喝彩；叫好；欢呼；鼓掌
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The wonderful performance won loud applause from the audience.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 精彩的表演赢得了观众热烈的掌声和喝彩。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: ap-(加强) + plaud(打击，拍手) -> 拼命拍手 -> 鼓掌，喝彩。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: adj. 艺术的美术的；有艺术性的；有美感的；精美的；有艺术鉴赏力的；有艺术修养的；有艺术天赋的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: She has a great artistic talent and loves painting traditional Chinese landscapes.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 她很有艺术天赋，喜欢画中国传统山水画。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: n. art(艺术) + -istic(形容词后缀，属于……的) -> 艺术的，有美感的。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: In one hall, I saw an artwork with thousands of glass "tears" falling down.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 合成词: art (艺术) + work (工作/作品) -> 艺术作品。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Scientists are studying whether an asteroid will pass close to the Earth.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 科学家们正在研究是否有一颗小行星会从地球附近掠过。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: aster(星星) + -oid(像……的) -> 像星星一样的小天体 -> 小行星。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Yang Liwei is China's first astronaut to travel into space.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 杨利伟是中国首位进入太空的宇航员。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: astro(星星) + naut(水手、航行者) -> 在星际航行的人 -> 宇航员。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The astronomer used a powerful telescope to discover a new star.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 这位天文学家使用一台高性能望远镜发现了一颗新星。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: astro(星星) + nomy(学科) + er(人) -> 研究星星的学科的人 -> 天文学家。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The manager asked his assistant to print out the meeting documents.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 经理让他的助手把会议文件打印出来。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: v. assist(帮助) + -ant(人或物后缀) -> 帮手，助手。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 体育运动；田径运动
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Tom is good at athletics, especially running and high jump.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 汤姆擅长体育运动，尤其是跑步和跳高。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: athlete(运动员) + -ics(学科/运动名词后缀) -> 田径运动，体育。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. (1) 大气；大气层；(2) 氛围；气氛；(3) 空気
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: There is a friendly and relaxing atmosphere in our English class.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 我们英语课堂的氛围友好而轻松。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: atmo(蒸汽、气体) + sphere(球体) -> 包围地球的气体球层 -> 大气层/气氛。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Pay attention to your body language.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: at + tend(倾向于) + ion = 集中注意力。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The glass doors of the supermarket open automatically when you approach.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 当你走近时，超市的玻璃门会自动打开。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: auto(自动) + matic(形容词后缀) -> 自动的。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: adj. 可利用的；可获得的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Tickets for the pop concert are available online now.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 流行音乐会的门票现在可以在网上买到。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: v. avail(有益、利用) + -able(能……的) -> 可以利用的，买得到的。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Students from different cultural backgrounds can learn a lot from each other.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 来自不同文化背景的学生可以互相学到很多东西。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: back(后面) + ground(地面/基础) -> 位于后面的衬托或基础 -> 背景。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Children should learn to behave well when they are in public places.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 小孩子们在公共场所时应该学会举止得体。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: be(加强) + have(拥有/使自己处于某种状态) -> 表现自己 -> 表现。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I recommend that you talk to your friend about his behaviour.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：be (是) + have (拥有) + iour -> 拥有一定表现，就是行为。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 支架；背带；牙箍 v. 使(身体或身体部位)顶住；使防备
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: He had to wear a dental brace to straighten his teeth.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 他不得不戴牙套来矫正牙齿。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 发音记忆：b(把……抱紧/固定) + race(竞赛) -> 为了跑步固定好 -> 支架/使稳固。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 广播节目；电视节目 v. 散布；广播
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The school radio station will broadcast the sports meeting results this evening.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 学校广播站将于今晚播报运动会成绩。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: broad(宽阔地) + cast(抛、撒) -> 像撒种一样向四面八方抛出信息 -> 广播。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Don't spend too much on holiday shopping, or you might go over budget.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 谐音记忆: “拔地鸡”，买这只鸡超出了我的预算 (budget)。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: v. 恐吓，伤害 n. 仗势欺人者
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We should stand up and say no to school bullies.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 我们应该勇敢站出来，向校园欺凌说不。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想：不理(buli)那些爱欺负人、恐吓别人的人 -> 霸凌，欺负者。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Walking along the Bund in Shanghai, you can see both old and modern buildings.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 漫步在上海外滩，你能看到古老与现代交融的建筑。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 同音词联想：bound(边界) -> 锁住河水的边界 -> 堤岸/外滩。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Archeologists found ancient tools near the burial site.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 考古学家在墓葬遗址附近发现了古代工具。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: v. bury(埋葬)的变体 + -al(名词后缀) -> 埋葬，葬礼。
